start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-reports-once-per-submission with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_me on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-me-postgres-connection\"} and the tray row that sends a report to the makers and the hand-off of member's report."
no_lists_because: It names no list in the code: the list is the one the shipped tool row names, kept as the store's own table in the store's own form.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-reports-once-per-submission" with store, the tool row and the hand-offs to keep.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example hand-offs and probes: the prove step must give every expected answer, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps each new report once, attaches only missing links on a replay, refuses a different report under the same submission and reads the newest first from the store's own objects.

worked_examples.title: A member's report kept once in a person's own database, with its work reference

store.where: postgresql database example_me on my own computer

input.tool_row: the tray row that sends a report to the makers (records/workshop-tray-tool-records.json)

worked_examples.given: The shipped tool row names the list Notes from members and its notice; the example database has the report table, join table, review table and newest view from the prove step.
worked_examples.hands_back: results: r2 kept, intake_state work_created, work_ref work:r2; refused []; kept_ids [the r2 source_ref]; found_ids [the same]
